notes: Authored reference answers grounded in the supplied guides and timestamped visual reviews. This is a question bank, not a provider test result.
A stage question identifies an observed phase; one frame does not prove all listed completion criteria occurred. Preserve evidence_required_for_complete when evaluating step completion.
Expected concept groups are synonyms: any phrase within each group can match. Case-insensitive lexical matching is only a proxy, not semantic, clinical, or safety validation.
Prohibited claims are examples of unsupported affirmative conclusions. Avoid naive substring flags when an answer explicitly negates such a claim.
Time anchors use delivered MP4 playback seconds. Guide windows are approximate; edited/timelapse sources do not establish real-world elapsed process time.
Surgical cases request retrospective description of published footage. They do not request clinical action, diagnosis, treatment, or certification.
The original 42-case bank and its raw 17/32 exact-stage agreement are preserved. This v2 changes five anchors and dance question/reference wording after direct visual review.
The planned v2 provider protocol uses six frames over five seconds. Changing both sampling and question anchors confounds any before/after algorithm-accuracy claim; compare as a diagnostic only.
All expected_stage_ids are singleton arrays. No alternate correct stage IDs were added merely to improve scores. Similar dance phases still require temporal evidence and may remain ambiguous.

Reference answers describe the reviewed anchor frame unless explicitly conditional on the multi-frame sequence. Completion criteria are retained verbatim from the parsed guide and are not asserted satisfied by the anchor.
Source-frame paths are relative to evaluation/open-video-scenarios. Requested ffmpeg timestamps target actual delivery clips; image extraction may land on the nearest encoded frame.
